header.title: 〈Sinai〉 Nr. 05: AI translation (Claude)
header.author: Rock inscriptions
header.source: Translated by Claude (claude-opus-5-5, Anthropic) from the library's urn:egy:tla:bbawfelsinschriften:sinai-nr-05:translit, from the Thesaurus Linguae Aegyptiae (2018), in Simon Schweitzer's AED-TEI (CC BY-SA 4.0), one English line for each line of the original. Only some passages are translated so far: those that the Atlas of Ancient Myth, Magic in the Ancient Texts and the demons-and-angels study cite.
header.statement: An AI-generated translation. No specialist has reviewed it.

nodes.text: King of Upper and Lower Egypt, Two Ladies Nebmaat, Golden Horus Snefru, Snefru the great god, given dominion, stability, life, health and joy of heart forever, Horus Nebmaat.
